WITH membership AS (
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
  UNION
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.number
  FROM membership AS m
  JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = m.pack_id
  JOIN document AS d ON d.id = m.cr
  WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-200683'
)
SELECT d.code AS disposition, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS document_count
FROM members AS m
JOIN disposition AS d ON d.target = m.id
WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY disposition;
